targets.expr: count((max by (UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$node"}) / (max by (UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$node"}) + max by (UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{Hostname=~"$node"}))) > 0.95) or vector(0)

(max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) / (max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{Hostname=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) + max by (Hostname, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{Hostname=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}))) * 100
